damit_id_meaning: DAMIT asteroid id (asteroids/view/<id>), not a model id
damit_model_reference: Marciniak et al. (2025); pole consistent with the 2023-08-31 occultation, doi:10.3847/PSJ/adb28c
archive: DAMIT (Database of Asteroid Models from Inversion Techniques), Astronomical Institute, Charles University, Prague
archive_reference: Durech, J., Sidorin, V., Kaasalainen, M. (2010), DAMIT: a database of asteroid models, Astronomy & Astrophysics 513, A46, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/200912693
gitignore_note: *.obj is ignored by this repository (.gitignore, a rule written for C object files -- PTM-303). This file is TRACKED anyway, through a named '!' exception on this exact path, so a fresh clone contains it and no force-add is needed. Do not remove that exception without also removing this file from the tree.

supersedes.note: The 2026-07-04 hand reconstruction (PTM-303), rebuilt from mesh.ply vertex/face data preserved in prior thermal-sim output. Measured against this DAMIT original on 2026-08-31: same 574 vertices and 1144 faces, identical face index lists, maximum in-order vertex deviation 0.000000000 km. The two differ only in header text and in decimal formatting (10 places written, 8 significant), which is why the md5 differs and the geometry does not. The original is kept as the tracked file because provenance, not geometry, is what separated them.
